name: Welcome to the Library
source:
A choose-your-own adventure style game set in the aisles of your local library, where the player must track down the required reading for their monthly book club. As they explore the library, fiction begins to distort the world around them into reflections of the books they seek. 

Choose between three different books and explore the genres they belong to! Fall in love, solve a crime, and even save your very soul. 

[From [url=https://smallbirds.itch.io/welcometothelibrary]Itch.io[/url]]
